procedure.method: Independent fresh craft review using only the explicitly pinned inputs. Packet, case, rules, rubric, compact method/addendum and adapter schema were read; all pinned input hashes and byte counts checked. The five pinned native-evidence manifests were read before poster viewing; no embedded unlisted source, maker, peer, planner or inspection paths were followed. Packet source_assets and protected_layouts are empty, so actual source opens and protected-layout reads are zero. tools.view_image with detail:'original' actually displayed each exact PNG sequentially: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same order. All fifteen displays were complete before the first text transcription, judgment or score. First readings were retained in packet copy order, with soft layout breaks distinct from word spacing. Only then one exact native revisit each of M1, M4 and M5 was performed for date/hour dash ambiguity; first raw readings remain unchanged and the six ambiguities remain unresolved. No images were generated, edited, cropped, substituted or newly downsampled. Native dimensions are 1672×941, using the declared 0.5-pixel integer-edge ratio tolerance; exact use views are 720×405 and thumbnails 320×180. Booleans attest this actual review procedure, not fabricated tool events; runtime session identity is unobserved and null.
